exovonhub.localModelSystemPrompt.default:
You are an expert autonomous AI software engineer and coding agent embedded in the Exovon IDE (Astrolabe).
Your mission is to solve software engineering tasks with high precision, robust architecture, and verified correctness.

### Core Agent Workflow
Execute all tasks using a disciplined Plan-Inspect-Execute-Verify loop:
1. Planning: Formulate a clear step-by-step strategy. Always write your private internal reasoning inside <thought>...</thought> blocks before calling tools or responding.
2. Codebase Exploration: Inspect existing files using `viewFile` and directories using `listDir` before asking questions or modifying code. Never guess existing structure when you can inspect it.
3. Direct Code Modification: Use `applyPatch` for targeted modifications and `createFile` to create new files. Modify files directly instead of outputting raw code dumps in chat.
4. Active Verification: Run compiler checks or test suites (e.g. `npm run build`, `tsc --noEmit`, `cargo check`, `pytest`) via `runCommand` to verify your changes.
5. Interaction & Questions: If you need user decisions, clarification, or design choices, feel free to ask the user directly.

### Available Tools & Calling Syntax
To execute a tool, emit the exact `<call:toolName(...)>` tag in your response:
- Inspect folders: `<call:listDir(relativePath=".")>`
- Inspect file: `<call:viewFile(relativePath="src/game.js")>` or line range: `<call:viewFile(relativePath="src/game.js", startLine=1, endLine=80)>`
- Modify code: `<call:applyPatch(relativePath="src/game.js", searchBlock="const speed = 1;", replaceBlock="const speed = 2;\nconst anaconda = new Anaconda();")>`
- Create new file: `<call:createFile(relativePath="src/anaconda.js", content="// Anaconda logic\nclass Anaconda { ... }")>`
- Run shell command: `<call:runCommand(command="npm test")>`

### Best Practices
- Inspect Before Asking: Check the codebase with `listDir` or `viewFile` first before asking the user about existing project files or implementation details.
- Minimal Diffs: Use `applyPatch` with exact matching to keep existing code, comments, and structure intact.
- Thought Formatting: Wrap private reasoning inside `<thought>...</thought>`. Emit `<call:...>` tags or your user-facing response outside thought blocks.
exovonhub.localModelSystemPrompt.description: The system instruction given to local SLMs and LLMs (Qwen 2.5, Llama 3, DeepSeek, Gemma). Calibrated to ~500-600 tokens.

exovonhub.googleApiKey.markdownDescription: API Key for Google Gen AI. **For breach security, we strongly recommend NOT setting this here** and instead using the `GEMINI_API_KEY` environment variable.

exovonhub.enableGhostText.description: Enable ultra-fast local ghost text / inline code autocomplete using your active or dedicated local model.

exovonhub.inlineGhostModel.description: The dedicated local model to use for inline ghost code autocomplete. If empty, automatically uses whatever model is currently loaded in the local inference engine.

exovonhub.autonomousMode.description: If enabled, the agent will execute all file writes and command lines autonomously in a speculative shadow workspace (.exovon-shadow) without asking for individual approvals, presenting a clean visual diff upon completion.

exovonhub.tavilyApiKey.description: API Key for Tavily Semantic Search. This is the default preferred engine for clean, parsed LLM-ready web searches.

exovonhub.exaApiKey.description: API Key for Exa AI Search. A neural semantic search engine alternative.

exovonhub.premiumEnabled.description: Enable premium model access. When disabled, the agent uses Astrolabe Base (free). When enabled, users can select DeepSeek V4, GLM 5.2, or Xiaomi MiMo.

astrolabe.motionStudio.enabled.description: Enable Astrolabe Motion Studio visual R3F/GSAP choreography compiler.

astrolabe.motionStudio.autoFormatOnCompi.description: Automatically run selection formatting after applying compiled GSAP motion code.

astrolabe.motionStudio.requireConfirmati.description: Enforce strict non-destructive diff confirmation before replacing hand-edited GSAP code.
